stations.title: Hold button
stations.text: On every card. A click does nothing.
stations.note: The shelf is a plain list.

captions: The stock shows up now. A regular wants a jazz and a blues record kept for Saturday.
Noor presses Hold on both, and the shelf still says nothing is on hold.
You give the screen a memory in App, in three tasks.
Now Hold puts a record on the shelf, Release takes it off, and the header counts.
Same two records, kept until Saturday. Every part of the screen agrees.
